lines.trans: She is just Vika, my girlfriend.
And this is Nastya, my friend.
Let's drink to seeing each other.
Why didn't you tell me she'd be here?
We spend a lot of time together.

words.gram: past plural, perfective; colloquial for 'let's go'

познакомиться.gloss: to get acquainted, to meet (for the first time)

meanings.en: to meet for the first time, to get acquainted

examples.trans: I dreamed of meeting your friends.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

вообще-то.gloss: actually, as a matter of fact

meanings.en: actually, strictly speaking, as a matter of fact
meanings.note: softens a correction or adds a second thought

examples.text: А вообще-то я ещё не решил.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: short forms знаком, знакома, знакомо, знакомы (+ dative)

examples.text: А знакомо ли тебе, Аркашка, слово педикюр?
examples.trans: And are you familiar, Arkashka, with the word pedicure?

examples.text: Я услышал в коридоре знакомый голос.
examples.trans: I heard a familiar voice in the corridor.

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!
I'll invite a female friend over.
Why are we going so slowly?

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

проводить.gloss: to see off, to see out

meanings.en: to see someone out, to see off
meanings.note: accompany someone to the door or the station
a different, imperfective verb проводить means 'to conduct, to spend (time)'

examples.trans: Well, probably somewhere in the archive.
He has probably already come home.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: + infinitive: Пора идти = Time to go

examples.trans: It's time for us to go.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: остаётся у нас = stays with us

meanings.en: to leave, to go away (on foot)

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: for movement; где is for location
